description: STAGE-CONSISTENCY BASELINE for saga #811 (issue #816 item 5): the `check()` half of a pair whose `-execute` sibling WAS a characterization fixture and is now a `REGRESSION WALL` — issue #815 flipped it, and no characterization fixture remains in the corpus. This half did not move, which is what the pair exists to show: the fix changed the run and left the check alone. This half is ALREADY CORRECT today and is expected to survive the fix UNCHANGED — it is precisely the answer the run path never consults, which is the whole of saga #811's shape-A mechanism. Fault shape A — an UNRESOLVABLE NAME in argument position. `check()` computes the right answer (`ol-unknown-command`, whose usual stage is `semantic` per spec/error-model.md:97) and `execute()` never consults it, so the statement is discarded whole with no diagnostic and no effect. The user-procedure form: `p` is well defined and correctly arity-2, and only its SECOND argument is unresolvable. The diagnostic points at `wibble`, not at `p` — the callee is fine.
